newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen mixed, heavy calendar of data due.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen mixed, heavy calendar of data due.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were seen opening mixed on Thursday after a precipitous drop in leading blue chip stocks in late trading Tuesday before the New Year holiday.

Several pieces of economic data were due during the day, including the key U.S. NAPM index of manufacturing activity for December at 1500 GMT. Traders will be closely watching the numbers for any signs of an overheating economy.
A report suggesting the economy might not be slowing as fast as Wall Street forecast sparked Tuesday's weakness.
